per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "posts"."id", "users"."displayname"
FROM "posts"
JOIN "users" ON "posts"."owneruserid" = "users"."id"
WHERE "posts"."creaiondate" >= '2010-01-01' AND "posts"."creaiondate" < '2011-01-01'
ORDER BY "posts"."score" DESC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(T2.CreaionDate AS TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY') = '2011' AND T1.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN u."reputation" > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DECIMAL / COUNT(*)::DECIMAL) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE p."creaiondate" >= '2011-01-01' AND p."creaiondate" < '2012-01-01'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(Reputation) AS max_reputation FROM users) AS T3 ON T1.Reputation = T3.max_reputation
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN "posts"."score" > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS "percentage"
FROM "posts"
WHERE "posts"."owneruserid" = (
    SELECT "id" 
    FROM "users" 
    ORDER BY "reputation" DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

per_case_results.question: Among the comments with scores between 5 to 10, what is the percentage of the users with 0 up votes?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.Id), 0) AS per FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "users"."upvotes" = 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) * 100 AS "percentage"
FROM "comments"
INNER JOIN "users" ON "comments"."userid" = "users"."id"
WHERE "comments"."score" BETWEEN 5 AND 10
LIMIT 500
